# Recurring taking keeps finite families from staying closed

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`no-finite-part-bears-taking` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](no-finite-part-bears-taking.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Under dissipation, a finite family on which taking recurs, with every finite family of distinct conditions containing it, is closed from no step on and, enclosed around, inward from no step on: it cannot stop drawing in from beyond it.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. On flows, a family of conditions is closed across a step when no formation taking part takes from or gives to a condition outside it; a formation dissipates on the family across the step when it gives the family no more than it takes from it, and less when it takes; a flow is dissipative when, across every step, every family without repetition closed across it is dissipated on. (`Becoming.Flow.ClosedAt`, `Becoming.Flow.DissipatesOn`, `Becoming.Flow.Dissipative`)
2. In a balanced flow a dissipated family falls across a step by at least its number of takers; dissipated from some step on, its takers over any later stretch number at most its stock there, and taking from it does not recur. (`Becoming.Flow.Balances.runs_down`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.takers_within`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.taking_not_recurring`, `Becoming.Web.stock`, `Becoming.Flow.takers`, `Becoming.falls_not_recurring`)
3. So in a balanced, dissipative flow a finite family from which formations take at arbitrarily late steps, together with every finite family without repetition containing it, is closed from no step on: that after any step some formation taking part exchanges with a condition outside it cannot be refuted. If finitely many conditions are all there is, taking does not recur. (`Becoming.Flow.Dissipative.opens`, `Becoming.Flow.takers_pos_of_sub`, `Becoming.Flow.Dissipative.finite_taking_not_recurring`)
4. Any recurring uptake is such taking: more without end, the unceasing arising of formations taking at their first active step, and maintenance, since a steady consumer with nothing arising and no growth needs it too. (`Becoming.Flow.More`, `Becoming.Flow.ArisesTaking`, `Becoming.Flow.More.takers_recur`, `Becoming.Flow.takers_recur_of_arising`, `Becoming.Flow.More.opens`, `Becoming.Flow.opens_of_arising`, `Becoming.Lone.lone`, `Becoming.Lone.frontier`)
5. A step encloses a family around when some finite family without repetition containing it is closed across the step; with decidable equality, every enclosed step encloses every finite family around. In a balanced, dissipative flow, where a family without repetition is enclosed around from some step on and taking from it recurs, it is inward from no step on (inward: every formation giving to it takes only from it). (`Becoming.Flow.Around`, `Becoming.Flow.Enclosed.around`, `Becoming.Flow.Inward`, `Becoming.Flow.Dissipative.dissipatesOn_of_inward`, `Becoming.Flow.taking_draws_in`)
6. Dissipation binds only where some finite family is closed: where a step's exchange lies within finitely many conditions without repetition, under dissipation a formation that gives takes more than it gives over every closed family without repetition, so giving needs uptake; where a formation exchanges with infinitely many conditions, no step is so, dissipation is vacuous, and a renewer can give while taking nothing. (`Becoming.Flow.Enclosed`, `Becoming.Flow.enclosed_of_finite`, `Becoming.Flow.Dissipative.gives_less`, `Becoming.Flow.Dissipative.giving_needs_uptake`, `Becoming.Spray.spray`, `Becoming.Spray.unenclosed`, `Becoming.Spray.dissipative`)
7. Each holds with its condition local: over a family closed and dissipated on across a step, a giver takes more than it gives; the bounds on takers, the end of recurring taking and drawing in need balance and dissipation only at the step, the stretch or the steps from some step on that are used, on the family used, closure entering only through the dissipation it gives. The forms above are corollaries. (`Becoming.Flow.DissipatesOn.gives_less_closed`, `Becoming.Flow.takers_within_on`, `Becoming.Flow.taking_not_recurring_from`, `Becoming.Flow.taking_not_recurring_within`, `Becoming.Flow.dissipatesOn_of_inward_at`, `Becoming.Flow.taking_draws_in_from`)
8. A flow in which a source burns a fresh fuel at every step, gives a pool less than it burns, and ever more growers take from the pool meets every premise and is more without end; the fuels it burns lie in no finite family, while each step is enclosed by the pool and that step's fuel, and the pool's family is inward from no step on, the fuel giving to it. (`Becoming.Frontier.flow`, `Becoming.Frontier.balances`, `Becoming.Frontier.dissipative`, `Becoming.Frontier.more`, `Becoming.Frontier.frontier`, `Becoming.Frontier.closed`, `Becoming.Frontier.enclosed`, `Becoming.Frontier.around`, `Becoming.Frontier.draws_in`)
9. With the growers depending on the pool, the same flow also meets a census and Taking, generation is unceasing, and through unceasing arising too the pool's families are closed from no step on. (`Becoming.Rooted.rooted`, `Becoming.Rooted.census`, `Becoming.Rooted.taking`, `Becoming.Rooted.arises_taking`)
10. Without dissipation a closed cycle is more without end, and none of the earlier flow witnesses in which taking recurs on one condition is dissipative. (`Becoming.Cycle.closed_more`, `Becoming.witnesses_not_dissipative`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- The flow balances the web; families of conditions and the formations taking part at each step are finite lists; amounts are natural numbers with commensurable units.
- Dissipation (Dissipative): across every step, on every family without repetition closed across it, every formation taking part gives the family no more than it takes from it, and less when it takes. It constrains only steps at which some finite family is closed; at a step whose exchange lies within finitely many conditions (Enclosed), giving needs uptake.
- For a quantity like free energy, dissipation and the finiteness of exchange are physical premises, not theorems.
- “Finite part” means a finite family of conditions; the conclusion constrains only taking in the flow.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Dissipation is vacuous where exchange reaches beyond every finite family; representations omitting the source (as in Expansion and Oscillation) do not meet it. Witness: `Becoming.Spray.spray`.
- The exchange beyond may be unrelated to the family (SprayShuttle); drawing in is stated only for a family enclosed around, which needs each step's exchange to lie within finitely many conditions. Witness: `Becoming.Flow.taking_draws_in`.
- A giver takes more than it gives only over a family without repetition. Witness: `Becoming.Lone.repeated_family`.
- Giving to a family not dissipated on need not take from it. Witness: `Becoming.Frontier.gives_without_taking`.
- The conclusion constrains only taking in the flow, not arising without taking (for embodied arising relata, see generation-is-replenishment). Witness: `Becoming.Tide.unrelated_depletion`.
- “Finite part” means a finite family of conditions, not a finite set of formations; formations and conditions remain two kinds here (one-kind readings: life-as-condition-of-life, generation-is-replenishment).
- Frontier is a minimal witness, and its endless source is only a representation.
- The comparison with heat death is the author's analogy.
- **Counterexample:** Without dissipation a closed finite family can be more without end (Cycle.closed_more): each formation gives back what it takes and the total never changes. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Flow.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Arising without taking is not constrained: the flicker of Tide draws on nothing and arises unceasingly (Tide.unrelated_depletion). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Arising.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The premises are consistent and the conclusion is attained (Frontier): a source burns a fresh fuel at every step, the flow balances, dissipates and is more without end, and every finite family containing the pool is closed from no step on; its growers depend on nothing, and the dependent version is Rooted. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Dissipation.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Dissipation constrains only steps at which some finite family is closed (Spray.spray): a sink exchanges with infinitely many auxiliary conditions, no step has a closed finite family, and dissipation holds vacuously; a renewer gives the pool at every step while taking nothing, and the exchange beyond is the sink's, unrelated to the pool. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Dissipation.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Recurring uptake need not come from more or from arising (Lone.lone, Lone.frontier): a single steady consumer, with nothing arising and no growth, under dissipation also leaves every finite family containing the pool closed from no step on. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Dissipation.lean)
- **Counterexample:** A positive witness of every premise (Rooted.rooted): with the growers depending on the pool, balance, Acting, Taking, Dependent, a census, dissipation, more and unceasing generation hold together, and the pool's families open by opens_of_arising; the expansion, cycle, pulse, steady consumer, repeated formation and oscillation are not dissipative (witnesses_not_dissipative). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Dissipation.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Recurring taking need not make a family draw in unless the family is enclosed around (SprayShuttle.taking_opens_anyway, opens_anyway): the sides take from their family at every step, the conclusion of Dissipative.opens is met by the sink's exchange with auxiliary relata, every relatum giving to the family takes only from it, and no step encloses the family around. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Roles.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Positive witnesses of enclosure around and drawing in (Frontier.enclosed, Frontier.around, Frontier.draws_in, Lone.enclosed, Lone.draws_in): Frontier, Rooted (which shares Frontier's flow) and Lone are enclosed at every step, and the pool's family is enclosed around and inward from no step on. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Dissipation.lean)
- **Counterexample:** “A formation giving to a family dissipated on takes from it” needs the family dissipated on: in Frontier the renewer gives to the pool without taking from it, the pool's family not being closed (Frontier.gives_without_taking); gives_less needs the family without repetition: in Lone the family listing the pool twice and that step's fuel is closed across the step, and the source gives it two units while taking two (Lone.repeated_family). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Dissipation.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The fourth independent review found that “no finite part is unceasing on its own” and “no finite part bears it alone” need a dissipation premise. This result states that premise and proves the claim for taking in flows. Ren's words are “生生不息 - 一种整体的，不断创造更多生的方向” (a whole direction of unceasingly creating more 生). The author reads the result as one formal content of “whole” in those words: under dissipation, recurring taking, whether of more, of generation or of maintenance (Lone), leaves the finite family of conditions on which it recurs closed from no step on, and a family enclosed around inward from no step on (taking_draws_in) (the author's interpretation); it does not replace Ren's words and does not show that it is good. Reading dissipation on free energy, matter can cycle within a finite family (Cycle) while the source driving the cycling must reach beyond every finite family (an AI argument). Whether actual quantities dissipate, and whether actual unfoldings are finite in this sense, are empirical questions. The new names are adopted under Ren's naming rule (DELEGATED-CHOICES D36).
